runtime_proof.measurement_basis: Playwright driving the real Next.js app at this head, plus one in-place mutation of the gate under test. No stub, no fixture UI.

queries.name: unauthenticated /submit is refused
queries.method: page.goto('/submit') with no session and no stored token
queries.result: Redirected to /login; the Capper Portal heading and the Continue with Google control rendered; the operator recovery token field stayed hidden behind its disclosure.
queries.significance: The gate refuses by default rather than rendering intake to an unauthenticated visitor.

queries.name: a forged capper token in localStorage does not open /submit
queries.method: A structurally valid JWT (real base64url header and payload, signature literal 'not-a-real-signature') written to localStorage.ut_capper_token, then page.goto('/submit')
queries.result: Redirected to /login. getByText('Forged Capper') and getByText('forged-capper') each resolved to count 0, so neither the forged display name nor the forged capper id rendered anywhere.
queries.significance: Client-held claims are not authority. The assertion is on absence of the forged identity, not merely on the URL.

queries.name: storing a recovery token does not sign the operator in
queries.method: Token pasted into the operator recovery field and submitted, then /submit requested
queries.result: The stored-token panel appeared and the operator stayed on /login; localStorage held the token; a subsequent /submit request still redirected to /login.
queries.significance: The token is retained for API bearer use while conferring no client-side session.

queries.name: mutation control: the gate fails when reverted
queries.method: app/submit/page.tsx reverted in place to the pre-lane ordering (grant on stored claim, before session resolution); the same three specs re-run; file restored before any commit
queries.result: Specs 2 and 3 failed on 'await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/)'. Spec 1 still passed.
queries.significance: The controls are proven to fail on the condition they name. Spec 1 passing under mutation correctly identifies it as not load-bearing.

queries.name: mutation control: the compiled-in allowlist constant is detected
queries.method: The allowlist export test run against the removed APPROVED_CAPPERS constant
queries.result: The test failed while the constant was present and passes with it removed.
queries.significance: The test detects the specific defect rather than passing vacuously.
